To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the soft modem can be made to be predictable and that the soft modem is a real-time application that can benefit from a real-time scheduler.
the soft modem requires 2.2% of the CPU time, 1.3% of the memory, 0.5% of the disk I/O, 1.1% of the network bandwidth, 0.2% of a 1.2 GHz CPU, and 0.1% of a 2.2 GHz CPU.

(1) soft modem computations are real-time computations and that (2) a soft modem can be implemented to provide predictability for its computations while minimizing its impact upon the rest of the system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question: How do you make a soft modem behave like a hard one?
how to design a real-time operating system to meet the predictability requirements of soft modems.
how to design and build operating systems that can support soft modems while still providing predictable performance to other applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a real-time scheduler is necessary for a soft modem.
a real-time operating system is a necessary and sufficient condition for predictable soft modem execution on commodity operating systems.
the use of real-time scheduling is the best way to provide predictable execution of soft modems on commodity hardware and operating systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a soft modem is an excellent candidate to be scheduled as a real-time task.
soft devices should be scheduled as independent tasks.
the real-time scheduling approach is a promising alternative to the existing interrupt-driven approach to signal processing in the soft modem.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the design of soft devices should not rely on the interrupt mechanism to provide predictable performance.
the design of soft devices needs to be revisited in order to make them predictable.
the real-time scheduling of soft devices is a critical design decision for the overall performance of a system.
